top_signals.title: Trump’s AI liability push opens blame game for models gone rogue
top_signals.summary: Further complicating any finding of responsibility, a model's behavior is shaped by both its AI developer and the end user deploying the system.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
